column1: # RSpace associative-commutative connective-domain algebra: universal-domain control versus PathMap union/intersection treatment.
# Production implementation: 4f022ad9b. Causal benchmark harness and measured source: efc48ab0d79cf0e9458ddf1535acae090ea60228.
# Host: AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 5975WX, 32 physical cores, SMT disabled; CPU 8 pinned; performance governor; no competing Cargo or rustc process at preflight.
# Preflight utilization: 86.25% aggregate idle; CPU 8 was 99.33% idle.

# Command: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=8G -p MemorySwapMax=0 taskset -c 8 cargo bench -p rholang --bench spatial_matcher_connective_domains --features spatial-matcher-connective-domain-differential -- --noplot --save-baseline exp248-final

# Arms: control forces the predecessor All candidate domain for a pure connective carrier; treatment uses the production PathMap<()> join/meet domain. Both arms contain the same ownership, iterator, and stack-safety repairs.

# Fixture: the preregistered primary is a width-4,096 rejecting OR chain. Five width-256 guardrails cover an exact diagonal, successful OR, successful AND, duplicate exact targets, and a Send remainder. Fixture construction/cloning is outside the timed interval.
# Criterion: one scientific run; 30 post-warm-up samples per arm/cell; 2 s warm-up; 5 s requested measurement interval; 99% confidence; 1% significance.

# Pgmcp experiment/hypothesis 248: ACCEPTED. Primary Welch t=-547.1086365660, one-sided p=4.0078949761e-60, Cohen's d=-141.2628425324, treatment-minus-control 95% CI [-28030114307.2690,-27821338501.0643] ns.

# Robustness: Cliff's delta=-1.0 and Mann-Whitney p=3.0198510359e-11. Primary mean latency falls 97.435360%, from 28.6607720873 s to 0.7350456831 s (38.991824x speedup), exceeding the preregistered 5% requirement.

# Guardrails: exact diagonal +0.185406%; Send remainder +0.167339%; duplicate exact -0.134776%; successful OR -93.272221%; successful AND -93.653571%. Every regression is below the preregistered 5% ceiling.

# Correctness/resource preflight: 15/15 focused recursive-oracle differentials with exact FreeMap equality; 51/51 deterministic edge-count replicates; depth-20,000 AND and OR on a 256 KiB stack; strict production-library Clippy.
# Scope: 1012.593 s wall; 999.044 s CPU; 251.7 MiB peak RSS; 8,192 MiB MemoryMax; zero swap.
